Most recent version: v3.4.27 (July 7, 2026) [top — bug fix only, below bar]

## v3.4.27 (July 7, 2026) [NEW since prior scan — below watching-tier bar]
- Fixed diff viewing issues in autonomous mode. (bug fix only; no new capability.)

## v3.4.22 (July 4, 2026) [reported 2026-07-05]
- **Devin Local autonomous mode with reviewable diffs**: edits in autonomous mode produce reviewable diffs; local agent harness runs autonomously — expanded local autonomous agent-execution surface.
- **`/mcp` slash command + live MCP server status panel**: in-session command to manage/inspect connected MCP servers with live status.
- Skill `permissions:` frontmatter now applies to auto-approvals; agent sidebar visible when routing to Cascade in agent-window mode; "New session in space"; Cloud sessions auto-reconnect; images copyable from chat; new users default to agent mode. [controls/reliability, below bar]
